prompt_en: Make a naturalistic editorial photograph in a contemporary public park that has quietly acquired LitRPG rules. The subject is a fictional woman whose facial and hair appearance is guided by the supplied reference photograph. Give this independently invented character an age of twenty-eight and the job of municipal gardener. Beside an unfinished root-removal task, she changes an ordinary task in response to her own game-system status. Her personal game-system display shows measurable resources and a skill state, with the resource value, its owner, and the response sharing one view. A compact translucent pane hangs at her chest side, with a fine luminous connection ending at her own wrist cuff. Its three large, clean lines read exactly "GARDENER LV 12", "STAMINA 8/100", and "ROOTBREAK 00:42"; a short amber resource bar reinforces the low number. She has stopped working: one knee rests on firm soil, her other boot is planted, and her right forearm rests on the raised knee while her gaze settles on the amber value. Her left gloved hand loosely holds the long wooden tool handle; the steel mattock head lies flat on the ground clear of her planted boot. The half-exposed thick root, fresh tool marks and small mound of loosened soil lie within arm's reach and make the unfinished work apparent. Her dark chin-length bob and fine parted fringe echo the reference, while a rolled-sleeve pale work shirt, olive trousers and soil-scuffed boots belong to this new circumstance. The relaxed mouth, patient tilted head and warm light through loose hair give her a quiet, appealing presence within the working pause. Show a real public path and park trees behind her, with morning maintenance light and tactile dirt. Use an eye-level three-quarter medium-wide view, keeping her face, both hands, the grounded tool head, stump and readable status pane within the same focused scene. The translucent interface remains subordinate to the believable person and physical task; the important visual rhythm runs from depleted stamina to her resting body to the stubborn root. Let the distant public path and tree shapes form a softly recognizable background layer while her face, personal status, hands, grounded tool and unfinished root remain crisp.
